interactions.summary: A student says Dante's Purgatory is the process-space between Hell and Heaven where self-reflection, prayer, and conviction allow movement upward through learned truth.
Jiang lists Dante's new system as democratic, hopeful, action-based, merciful, and just, while a student adds that it works through deeds rather than payment.
interactions.speaker_attribution: Jiang exposition with a student confirmation.

claims.claim: Jiang says that before Dante Purgatory was for special cases and mostly for people rich enough to pay indulgences, so it did not apply to most people.
The student synthesis Jiang accepts defines Purgatory as a process of self-reflection, prayer, conviction, and learning rather than a static zone between Hell and Heaven.
Jiang argues that Dante's Purgatory is democratic because anyone can participate in it, including the poor through prayer, instead of only the wealthy through church payment.
He says Dante's system is hopeful because even bad people can still gain access to Purgatory through repentance, love from others, or prior acts of goodness.
Jiang contrasts Dante's action-based and merciful Purgatory with a church system that incentivizes obedience and restricts Heaven to a narrow elite.

signature_moments.moment: Dante's Purgatory is called democratic because even the poor can still act for the dead through prayer.
signature_moments.source_phrase: if you're poor, you can still pray for your loved one in Purgatory
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It turns afterlife justice from a market transaction into a participatory moral order.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang says the church teaches against hope while Dante rebuilds the whole system around hope's persistence.
signature_moments.source_phrase: the Catholic Church teaches you not to have any hope
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This is one of the lecture's sharpest oppositions between institutional Christianity and Dante's cosmology.

signature_moments.moment: Anyone can access Heaven now, but only through hard inner work rather than purchased exemption.
signature_moments.source_phrase: anyone everyone can access heaven but you have to work hard
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It captures the mix of universal accessibility and demanding effort Jiang sees as Dante's breakthrough.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Jiang's phrase for Dante's model in which access and participation are open beyond the wealthy elite.
A structure where deeds, repentance, and effort matter more than money or institutional permission.
Jiang's paired standard for why Dante's revised Purgatory coheres with a God of love.

chronology_notes.note: The lecture's June 26 argument now shifts from diagnosing the church's older loophole model to naming the features Dante must introduce for a coherent cosmology of love.
